title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #6 (Term 3)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #6 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which verse tells children to obey parents in the Lord? (1 mark)
   A. Ephesians 6:1
   B. John 3:16
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. Genesis 12:1

2. Who ate the fruit God had forbidden? (1 mark)
   A. Adam and Eve
   B. Abraham and Sarah
   C. Joseph and Mary
   D. Peter and John

3. What did Jesus do to the children? (1 mark)
   A. Gave them money
   B. Ignored them
   C. Placed His hands on them and blessed them
   D. Sent them home

4. Who is your neighbour? (1 mark)
   A. Only friends
   B. Only people next door
   C. Anyone near you or in need
   D. Only relatives

5. How should you care for an exercise book? (1 mark)
   A. Cover it and keep it clean
   B. Draw on it
   C. Tear it
   D. Leave it in the rain

6. In 1 Corinthians 6:19, what does Paul call the body of a believer? (1 mark)
   A. Property of strangers
   B. Temples of the Holy Spirit
   C. Machines
   D. Toys

7. What does it mean to glorify God with our bodies? (1 mark)
   A. To ignore Him
   B. To boast
   C. To honour Him by how we use them
   D. To hurt others

8. Who came to Jesus in the temple after the clearing? (1 mark)
   A. Kings
   B. Soldiers
   C. The blind and the lame
   D. Tax collectors

9. Which behaviour shows respect for the church? (1 mark)
   A. Littering
   B. Entering quietly
   C. Running
   D. Shouting

10. Which disciple was a tax collector? (1 mark)
   A. Matthew
   B. Philip
   C. Andrew
   D. Peter

11. Which two disciples were brothers, sons of Zebedee? (1 mark)
   A. James and John
   B. Matthew and Thaddaeus
   C. Peter and Andrew
   D. Thomas and Philip

12. What should you do if a group invites you to do something wrong? (1 mark)
   A. Keep it secret
   B. Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult
   C. Ask for more
   D. Join in

13. Which is a group that a child should not join? (1 mark)
   A. A Bible club
   B. A church choir
   C. A gang that does wrong
   D. A football team with good rules

14. When can Christians pray? (1 mark)
   A. Only on Sunday
   B. Any time and anywhere
   C. Only in church
   D. Only at night

15. Which action shows goodness? (1 mark)
   A. Lying
   B. Cheating
   C. Returning extra change to a shopkeeper
   D. Stealing

16. Which of these is a fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Jealousy
   B. Kindness
   C. Anger
   D. Greed

17. Which decision step comes first? (1 mark)
   A. Copy others
   B. Stop and think
   C. Choose quickly
   D. Ask nobody

18. What does self-control mean? (1 mark)
   A. Doing whatever you want
   B. Being loud
   C. Being lazy
   D. Controlling your words, actions and wishes

19. What is social media? (1 mark)
   A. A market
   B. Websites and apps that let people share messages, pictures and videos
   C. A school
   D. A newspaper

20. What is cyberbullying? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing kind words
   B. Praying online
   C. Sending hurtful messages to others
   D. Watching a lesson

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. State three reasons why we should care for school property. (3 marks)

22. State two ways of glorifying God with our bodies. (2 marks)

23. Describe how the early church began. (4 marks)

24. Describe what a child should do when they lose or break something belonging to someone else. (3 marks)

25. Explain what the Lord's Prayer teaches about forgiveness and protection. (5 marks)

26. Give three reasons why children should not join ungodly groups. (3 marks)

27. Explain what it means to say that love is a choice. (4 marks)

28. Describe what a child should do after sinning, in four steps. (4 marks)

29. State two things that the story of Jesus blessing children teaches. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #6 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Ephesians 6:1
   Ephesians 6:1 says this.

2. A — Adam and Eve
   Genesis 3 tells about Adam and Eve.

3. C — Placed His hands on them and blessed them
   Matthew 19:15 says He blessed them.

4. C — Anyone near you or in need
   A neighbour is anyone we can help.

5. A — Cover it and keep it clean
   Covers protect books.

6. B — Temples of the Holy Spirit
   The body is a temple.

7. C — To honour Him by how we use them
   We honour God by how we live.

8. C — The blind and the lame
   Matthew 21:14 says He healed them.

9. B — Entering quietly
   Quiet respect honours God's house.

10. A — Matthew
   Matthew was a tax collector.

11. A — James and John
   James and John were sons of Zebedee.

12. B — Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult
   Refuse and seek help.

13. C — A gang that does wrong
   Ungodly groups lead to harm.

14. B — Any time and anywhere
   God hears us always.

15. C — Returning extra change to a shopkeeper
   Goodness is doing what is right.

16. B — Kindness
   Kindness is listed.

17. B — Stop and think
   Stopping helps you decide well.

18. D — Controlling your words, actions and wishes
   Self-control means governing yourself.

19. B — Websites and apps that let people share messages, pictures and videos
   Social media lets people connect.

20. C — Sending hurtful messages to others
   Bullying can happen online.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: It belongs to everyone; repair costs money; a clean school helps learning; others will use it later.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep clean and healthy, speak kindly, avoid harmful things, use hands to help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: The Holy Spirit came at Pentecost, Peter preached, people asked what to do, Peter told them to repent and be baptised, about three thousand believed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tell the owner honestly, say sorry, offer to replace or repair it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

25. (5 marks)
   Answer: We ask God to forgive us as we forgive others, so we must forgive. We ask Him to lead us away from temptation and to deliver us from evil, so we depend on His protection and try to avoid wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's forgiveness, 1 for forgiving others, 1 for temptation, 1 for evil, 1 for depending on God.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: They lead to wrong; they can harm us; they pull us from God and family; they ask for secrets.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: We do not always feel like loving. We can still choose to be kind, like helping someone who annoyed us. Love shows in actions.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not always feeling, 1 for choosing kindness, 1 for example, 1 for actions.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Admit it, say sorry to God, say sorry to the person hurt, put things right, decide not to repeat.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step up to 4.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Jesus loves children; children are important; they are welcome in God's kingdom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.
